name: Dalker remote-session border
description: Draws a red frame around every monitor while someone is viewing or controlling this desktop through Dalker. Driven over D-Bus (io.github.ivanmakhnyk.Dalker); hides itself if the Dalker agent stops pinging. While someone is viewing, it also shares the clipboard text with the Dalker agent and types the text a viewer sends in Direct text keyboard mode.
